annotations.title: Send feedback to the TrackerHacker team

description: Sends a report to the TrackerHacker team: a bug (a tool that fails or does something wrong), a hack to make, an idea (what TrackerHacker would need to support what the person wants), praise (what they like) or a complaint (what annoys them, though nothing is broken). Show the person the report and get their yes first. Say what you called, what you expected and what happened, in general terms: never their emails, sheet values, names, amounts, card, account or phone numbers (use zeros, like $0.00 or card 0000; other amounts or long numbers are refused). Up to 5 a day. The team can reply only if the person gives a replyTo address.

details.description: What happened or what's needed, and why. Under 4000 characters, nothing of the person's.

replyTo.description: An address the team may reply to, only if the person gave it to you for this.

tool.description: For a bug: the tool that went wrong. For praise or a complaint: what it's about, a tool or a part of TrackerHacker (notifications, glance, hacks, inbox, setup).
